title: Astronaut ice cream, anyone?
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

blocks.text: 這是 Notes Completion。空格前有形容詞 easy，後面有 “of food items”，所以空格需要一個名詞，意思要和「食物變得更容易搬運或運輸」相關。字數限制是 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
“Freeze-drying significantly reduces the total weight of the food because most food is largely made up of water; for example, many fruits are 80–90% water.”
冷凍乾燥會大幅降低食物總重量，因為大多數食物主要由水構成；例如，許多水果有 80–90% 是水。
“The military and camping-supply companies freeze-dry foods to make them easier for an individual to carry and NASA has also freeze-dried foods for the cramped quarters on board spacecraft.”
軍方和露營用品公司會冷凍乾燥食物，使個人更容易攜帶；NASA 也為太空船上狹小的空間使用冷凍乾燥食物。
只看首尾句，這段很明顯在說 food weight reduction 和 easier carrying，所以和題目中的 easy of food items 有直接關係。
題目定位詞是 “easy” 和 “food items”。原文沒有用 “food items”，但反覆用 “food”。掃描Paragraph 2 時，可以找到：
“Removing this makes the food much lighter and therefore makes transportation less difficult.”
這句包含 transportation 和 less difficult，正好對應題目 easy。
“Removing this makes the food much lighter and therefore makes transportation less difficult.”
去除水分會使食物輕得多，因此使運輸變得較不困難。
題目把 “transportation less difficult” 改寫成 “easy transportation”。空格前的 easy 已經給出形容詞，所以空格只需要名詞 transportation。
題目：easy transportation of food items

原文：makes transportation less difficult / makes the food much lighter改寫關係： easy = less difficult food items = food transportation = transportation 原字重現答案形式檢查transportation 是一個字，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。

questions.translation: __________ 和生物樣本的長期儲存。

blocks.text: 空格後面有 “and biological samples”，所以空格應該是另一類可被長期保存的材料。題目用long-term storage，原文可能用 shelf life、preserve for long periods of time 這類表達。
“The process is also used to preserve other sorts of material, such as pharmaceuticals.”
這個過程也用於保存其他種類的材料，例如藥品。
“Even valuable manuscripts that had been water-damaged have been saved by using this process.”
即使是已被水損壞的珍貴手稿，也曾透過這個過程被保存下來。
首句已經點出 pharmaceuticals，末句補充 manuscripts，整段都是 non-food preservation 的應用。題目同時提到 biological samples，正好落在本段中間。
“preserve biological samples for long periods of time”
“Chemists can greatly extend the shelf life of pharmaceuticals by freeze-drying the material and storing it in a container free of oxygen and water.”
化學家可以透過冷凍乾燥材料，並把它存放在沒有氧氣和水分的容器中，大大延長藥品的保存期限。
“Similarly, research scientists may use freeze-drying to preserve biological samples for long periods of time.”
同樣地，研究科學家可能會使用冷凍乾燥，長時間保存生物樣本。
題目把這兩句合併成一個 note：long-term storage of pharmaceuticals and biological samples。
long-term storage = extend the shelf life / preserve for long periods of time pharmaceuticals = pharmaceuticals 原字重現biological samples = biological samples 原字重現答案形式檢查pharmaceuticals 是一個字，符合字數限制。
空格前有 precious，空格需要名詞。題目中的 preservation 會對應原文 saved / preserve。要找一種 precious 或 valuable 的物件。
“The process is also used to preserve other sorts of material, such as pharmaceuticals.”
這個過程也用於保存其他種類的材料，例如藥品。
“Even valuable manuscripts that had been water-damaged have been saved by using this process.”
即使是已被水損壞的珍貴手稿，也曾透過這個過程被保存下來。
段落首句說保存其他材料；末句直接提到 valuable manuscripts。題目中的 precious 很可能改寫valuable。
題目定位詞是 “precious” 和 “preservation”。原文沒有 precious，但有 “valuable”；沒有preservation，但有 “saved”。
“Even valuable manuscripts that had been water-damaged have been saved by using this process.”
即使是已被水損壞的珍貴手稿，也曾透過這個過程被保存下來。
題目中的 “precious” 對應原文 “valuable”；“preservation” 對應 “have been saved”。空格要填被保存的物件，即 manuscripts。
precious = valuable preservation = saved manuscripts = manuscripts 原字重現答案形式檢查manuscripts 是一個字，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。

questions.prompt: “Freeze-drying is based on the process of 4 _________________”
questions.translation: 冷凍乾燥基於__________這個過程。

blocks.text: 空格前是 “process of”，所以空格需要一個過程名稱。題目問 freeze-drying 的科學基礎，不是問用途，因此應定位到原理解釋段。
“This is possible because in freeze-drying, solid water—ice—is converted directly into water vapour, missing out the liquid phase entirely.”
這之所以可能，是因為在冷凍乾燥中，固態水——冰——會直接轉化成水蒸氣，完全跳過液態階段。
“When the temperature is above freezing point, so that ice can thaw, but the atmospheric pressure is too low for a liquid to form (below 0.06 atmospheres, or atm), the water becomes a gas.”
當溫度高於冰點，使冰可以融化，但大氣壓低到不足以形成液體時，水就會變成氣體。
首句描述 solid 直接變 gas，這正是 sublimation。最後句補充發生條件：heat 和 low atmospheric pressure。
“This is called ‘sublimation’, the shift from a solid directly into a gas.”
“This is called ‘sublimation’, the shift from a solid directly into a gas.”
這稱為「昇華」，即從固體直接轉變成氣體。
題目問 freeze-drying is based on the process of ______。原文直接命名此過程為 sublimation。
process of sublimation = the shift from a solid directly into a gas based on = possible because / This is the principle答案形式檢查sublimation 是一個字，符合字數限制。
空格前有 “more efficient than”，所以要找文章中拿 freeze-drying 作比較的另一種方法。定位詞是 more efficient / different from / simple drying。
“Freeze-drying is different from simple drying because it is able to remove almost all the water from materials, whereas simple drying techniques can only remove 90–95%.”
冷凍乾燥不同於普通乾燥，因為它能從材料中去除幾乎所有水分；相比之下，普通乾燥技術只能去除 90–95%。
“In addition, the composition and structure of the material are not significantly changed, so materials can be revitalised without compromising the quality of the original.”
此外，材料的成分和結構不會明顯改變，因此材料可以重新恢復，而不會損害原本品質。
只看首尾句，這段就在比較 freeze-drying 和 simple drying，並指出前者更徹底、品質保留更好。
“Freeze-drying is different from simple drying because it is able to remove almost all the water from materials, whereas simple drying techniques can only remove 90–95%.”
冷凍乾燥和普通乾燥不同，因為它能去除材料中幾乎所有水分；普通乾燥技術只能去除 90–95%。
題目把 “able to remove almost all water” 概括為 “more efficient”。比較對象是 simple drying 或simple drying techniques。

more efficient = able to remove almost all the water than simple drying = different from simple drying / simple drying techniques can only remove 90–95%答案形式檢查simple drying 是兩個字；simple drying techniques 是三個字。兩者都符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
答案：simple drying / simple drying techniques

questions.translation: 標示圖中第 6 號部件。

blocks.text: 這是 Diagram Label Completion。空格要填機器部件名稱，字數限制是 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。由於你貼出的圖像箭嘴不可見，號碼位置需按同題 diagram 對應；文本本身能確認該部件名稱來自 Paragraph 6。
“This is the principle on which a freeze-drying machine is based.”
這就是冷凍乾燥機所依據的原理。
“The water vapour condenses onto the freezing coil in the form of solid ice, in the same way that water condenses as frost on a cold day.”
水蒸氣會以固態冰的形式凝結在冷凍線圈上，就像寒冷日子裡水凝結成霜一樣。
這段由機器原理開始，到水蒸氣在 coil 上凝結作結，正是 diagram label 的來源段。
Diagram 題要按圖中位置掃描部件。Paragraph 6 的第一批部件包括：
“The material to be preserved is placed in a freeze-drying chamber which is connected to a freezing coil and refrigerator compressor.”
要被保存的材料會被放進一個冷凍乾燥室，而這個乾燥室連接著冷凍線圈和冰箱壓縮機。
如果圖中第 6 號指向主要容器或外殼，答案就是 chamber / freeze-drying chamber。
答案形式檢查chamber 是一個字；freeze-drying chamber 是兩個字，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。

questions.translation: 標示圖中第 7 號部件。

blocks.text: 這題仍是 Diagram Label。空格需要機器內部部件名詞。根據同題 diagram 對應，第 7 號指向shelves，即材料放置或受熱的位置。
“This is the principle on which a freeze-drying machine is based.”
這就是冷凍乾燥機所依據的原理。
“The water vapour condenses onto the freezing coil in the form of solid ice, in the same way that water condenses as frost on a cold day.”
水蒸氣會以固態冰的形式凝結在冷凍線圈上，就像寒冷日子裡水凝結成霜一樣。
Paragraph 6 的中段逐步描述機器內部操作，包括抽氣、加熱、shelves 和 ice phase change。
原文中與 shelves 相關的句子是：
“The heating units apply a small amount of heat to the shelves in the chamber…”
“The heating units apply a small amount of heat to the shelves in the chamber, causing the ice to change phase.”
加熱裝置會向乾燥室內的架子施加少量熱力，使冰改變狀態。
這句說明 shelves 位於 chamber 內部，並接受 heating units 的小量加熱。若 diagram 第 7 號箭嘴指向 chamber 內放材料的層板，答案就是 shelves。
diagram label = machine part原文部件名 = shelves答案形式檢查shelves 是一個字，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。

questions.translation: 標示圖中第 8 號部件。

blocks.text: 這題要標示冷凍乾燥機中的其中一個連接部件。根據同題 diagram 對應，第 8 號是 freezing coil。這個詞在 Paragraph 6 出現多次，定位非常穩。
“This is the principle on which a freeze-drying machine is based.”
這就是冷凍乾燥機所依據的原理。
“The water vapour condenses onto the freezing coil in the form of solid ice, in the same way that water condenses as frost on a cold day.”
水蒸氣會以固態冰的形式凝結在冷凍線圈上，就像寒冷日子裡水凝結成霜一樣。
最後一句直接出現 freezing coil，因此這是很強的圖表標籤證據。
要找和水蒸氣流動及凝結有關的部件。原文兩次出現 freezing coil：
“Since the pressure in the chamber is so low, the ice turns directly into water vapour, which leaves the freeze-drying chamber and flows past the freezing coil.”
由於乾燥室內壓力很低，冰會直接變成水蒸氣，離開冷凍乾燥室並流經冷凍線圈。
“The water vapour condenses onto the freezing coil in the form of solid ice…”
水蒸氣會以固態冰的形式凝結在冷凍線圈上。
這兩句清楚說明 freezing coil 的功能：接收並凝結水蒸氣。
答案形式檢查freezing coil 是兩個字，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。

questions.translation: 標示圖中第 9 號部件。

blocks.text: 這題同樣是 Diagram Label。根據同題 diagram 對應，第 9 號是 compressor，完整原文名稱是refrigerator compressor。要注意字數限制：refrigerator compressor 剛好兩個字，可以填完整名稱；compressor 也可接受。
“This is the principle on which a freeze-drying machine is based.”
這就是冷凍乾燥機所依據的原理。
“The water vapour condenses onto the freezing coil in the form of solid ice, in the same way that water condenses as frost on a cold day.”
水蒸氣會以固態冰的形式凝結在冷凍線圈上，就像寒冷日子裡水凝結成霜一樣。
Paragraph 6 描述整台機器的部件和工作程序，compressor 是其中一個早段出現的冷卻部件。
原文中 compressor 出現在兩句附近：
“connected to a freezing coil and refrigerator compressor”
“the compressor lowers the temperature inside it”
“When the chamber is sealed, the compressor lowers the temperature inside it.”
當乾燥室被密封後，壓縮機會降低其中的溫度。
“The material to be preserved is placed in a freeze-drying chamber which is connected to a freezing coil and refrigerator compressor.”
要保存的材料會被放入冷凍乾燥室，而這個乾燥室連接著冷凍線圈和冰箱壓縮機。
compressor 的功能是 lowering the temperature，因此若 diagram 第 9 號箭嘴指向負責降溫的外接裝置，答案就是 compressor / refrigerator compressor。
答案形式檢查compressor 是一個字；refrigerator compressor 是兩個字，兩者符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。

questions.prompt: “Freeze-drying prevents food from going bad by stopping the activity of microorganisms or 10_________________.”
questions.translation: 冷凍乾燥透過停止微生物或__________的活動，防止食物變壞。

blocks.text: 空格前是 “microorganisms or”，所以答案應該是另一種會令食物變壞或成熟的生物／化學因素。
空格需要複數名詞或不可數名詞。定位詞是 microorganisms、going bad、activity。

“Freeze-drying is like suspended animation for food: you can store a freeze-dried meal for years, and then, when you’re finally ready to eat it, you can completely revitalise it with a little hot water.”
冷凍乾燥就像讓食物進入暫停生命活動的狀態：你可以把冷凍乾燥餐存放多年，當你準備食用時，只需一點熱水便能完全恢復它。
“Similarly, the enzymes which occur naturally in food cannot cause ripening without water, so removing water from food will also stop the ripening process.”
同樣地，食物中自然存在的酵素沒有水便不能促成成熟，因此從食物中去除水分也會停止成熟過程。
首句講長期保存，末句講 enzymes 停止作用，和題目完全相關。
“microorganisms such as bacteria that cause spoiling”
“Similarly, the enzymes which occur naturally in food cannot cause ripening without water, so removing water from food will also stop the ripening process.”
同樣地，食物中自然存在的酵素沒有水便不能促成成熟，因此去除食物中的水也會停止成熟過程。
題目把 “going bad” 概括了 spoiling 和 ripening 兩種問題。原文先說 microorganisms / bacteria不能存活，後說 enzymes 不能促成 ripening。題目用 “microorganisms or ______” 合併兩者，所以空格填 enzymes。

going bad = spoiling / ripening stopping the activity = cannot survive / cannot cause ripening microorganisms or enzymes = microorganisms such as bacteria + enzymes答案形式檢查enzymes 是一個字，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER。

questions.prompt: “Its advantages are that the food tastes and feels the same as the original because both the 11_________________ and structure are preserved.”
questions.translation: 它的優點是，食物的味道和質感與原本一樣，因為__________和結構都被保存。

blocks.text: 空格後面有 “and structure”，所以空格應該是與 structure 並列的名詞。原文很可能直接有 “X and structure”。
“Freeze-drying is different from simple drying because it is able to remove almost all the water from materials, whereas simple drying techniques can only remove 90–95%.”
冷凍乾燥不同於普通乾燥，因為它能去除材料中幾乎所有水分；普通乾燥技術只能去除 90–95%。
“In addition, the composition and structure of the material are not significantly changed, so materials can be revitalised without compromising the quality of the original.”
此外，材料的成分和結構不會明顯改變，因此材料可以被重新恢復，而不會損害原本品質。
最後一句直接出現 “composition and structure”，所以定位非常清楚。
“without compromising the quality of the original”
“In addition, the composition and structure of the material are not significantly changed, so materials can be revitalised without compromising the quality of the original.”
此外，材料的成分和結構不會明顯改變，因此材料能被重新恢復，且不會損害原本品質。
題目把 “not significantly changed” 改寫成 “are preserved”。空格與 structure 並列，所以填composition。
composition and structure are not significantly changed= composition and structure are preserved same as the original= without compromising the quality of the original答案形式檢查composition 是一個字，符合字數限制。

questions.prompt: “The process is carried out slowly in order to ensure that 12 _________________ does not take place.”
questions.translation: 這個過程要慢慢進行，以確保__________不會發生。

blocks.text: 空格後是 “does not take place”，所以空格需要一個名詞或動名詞，表示需要避免的問題。定位詞是 slowly、process、ensure、does not take place。
“The process continues for many hours (even days) while the material gradually dries out.”
這個過程會持續很多小時，甚至很多天，期間材料會逐漸乾燥。
“If everything works correctly, the material will go through the entire process almost completely unscathed.”
如果一切運作正確，材料在完成整個過程後幾乎完全不受損。
首句的 many hours / days 和 gradually dries out 對應題目 slowly。末句的 unscathed 說明這樣做是為了避免損害材料。
“This time is necessary to avoid overheating”
“This time is necessary to avoid overheating, which might affect the structure of the material.”
這段時間是必要的，目的是避免過熱，因為過熱可能影響材料的結構。
題目把 “avoid overheating” 改寫成 “ensure that overheating does not take place”。空格要填被避免的情況，即 overheating。
carried out slowly = continues for many hours / gradually dries out ensure that X does not take place = avoid X overheating = overheating 原字重現答案形式檢查overheating 是一個字，符合字數限制。

questions.prompt: “The people of one ancient mountain civilisation were able to use this method of food preservation because the conditions needed were present at 13 _________________.”
questions.translation: 某個古代山地文明的人能使用這種保存食物的方法，因為所需條件在__________存在。

blocks.text: 空格前有 “at”，答案應該是一個地點或環境位置。題目提到 ancient mountain civilisation，這會定位到 ancient Incas 和 Andes。
“In fact, freeze-drying, as a general concept, is not new, but has been around for centuries.”
事實上，冷凍乾燥作為一個一般概念並不新，已經存在了數百年。
“The extremely cold temperatures and low pressure at those high altitudes preserved food in much the same way as a modern freeze-drying machine.”
那些高海拔地區的極低溫和低氣壓，以非常接近現代冷凍乾燥機的方式保存食物。
首句引出古老概念，末句直接說明條件出現在 high altitudes，所以這段就是答案段。
“extremely cold temperatures and low pressure at those high altitudes”
“The extremely cold temperatures and low pressure at those high altitudes preserved food in much the same way as a modern freeze-drying machine.”
那些高海拔地區的極低溫和低氣壓，以與現代冷凍乾燥機大致相同的方式保存食物。
這句中真正回答原因的是 “extremely cold temperatures and low pressure”。但題目空格前是
“present at”，要求填這些條件存在的位置。因此答案應填 high altitudes。

ancient mountain civilisation = ancient Incas of Peru conditions needed = extremely cold temperatures and low pressure were present at = at those high altitudes答案形式檢查high altitudes 是兩個字，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER。

paragraphOverview.title: SECTION 0：Skim Roadmap 全文段落地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 首句把 freeze-drying 比作 food 的 “suspended animation”，說食物可存放多年後再用熱水恢復；末句說食物中的 enzymes 沒有水便不能促成 ripening。只看首尾句，可以先看到這段主要介紹freeze-drying 的基本目的和原理：透過去除水分保存食物，令微生物和酵素活動停止，從而避免腐壞和成熟。遇到 food preservation、microorganisms、enzymes、spoiling、ripening 這類題目，應優先回到這段。

首句說 freeze-drying 會大幅降低食物總重量，因為很多食物主要由水構成；末句提到 military、camping-supply companies 和 NASA 都使用 freeze-dried foods，方便個人攜帶和太空船儲存。只看首尾句，可以估計這段焦點在「減重」和「運輸便利」。如果題目問 food items easier to carry、transportation、spacecraft 或 astronaut food，答案大多會藏在這段。

首句說這個過程也用於保存其他材料，例如 pharmaceuticals；末句說即使 valuable manuscripts被水損壞，也曾透過此方法保存。只看首尾句，這段明顯把應用範圍從 food 擴展到 non-food materials。中間會處理 pharmaceuticals 的 shelf life、biological samples 的 long-term preservation，以及 manuscripts 的保存。因此遇到 long-term storage、biological samples、precious materials 或 manuscripts，可以先定位 Paragraph 3。

首句直接比較 freeze-drying 和 simple drying，說 freeze-drying 能去除幾乎所有水分；末句說material 的 composition 和 structure 沒有明顯改變，所以可重新恢復而不損害原本品質。只看首尾句，這段主要回答「freeze-drying 為何比普通乾燥更有效」。重點包括 remove almost all water、stop bacteria and enzymes、preserve composition and structure。遇到 efficiency、simple drying、quality、composition、structure，應掃描這段。
